title: Satarupa
desc: Dr. Rupa unintentionally causes Shatadal's memory loss, leading him to see her as his only kin. Later, they fall for each other but when his past returns, he forgets her.

title: Praner Swami
desc: A businessman unsuccessfully looks for a prospective bride for his grandson, Moti. Later, Moti marries a woman, Moyna, of his choice, but she catches his friend's dirty eyes who wants her for himself.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Debibaran
desc: Satyapriyo fights for justice when his sister is raped. During his fight, he takes on a corrupt village official in a twisted turn of events.
